A coding agent asks for an API key: raw CLI, then through a secret broker

svg.text: The agent asks the vault CLI for an API key
The CLI wants a human to approve
Someone clicks yes and the risk spreads
The raw key lands in the agent's chat
Same request, with a secret broker in between
The agent asks the broker for a reference
The broker asks once; the human approves once
Only a reference goes back to the agent
Secrets go to processes, never to the agent
